title: Git Rebase TLDR
description: Quick reference for when and how to use git rebase safely.

entries.anchor: Keep feature branch up to date with main
entries.content: Use rebase to replay your commits on top of latest main and keep history linear.

entries.anchor: Clean up local commit history before opening a PR
entries.content: Interactive rebase can squash or reorder commits into a clearer story.

entries.anchor: Rebase commits already shared with teammates
entries.content: Avoid this unless coordinated, because rebasing rewrites commit hashes.
git fetch origin && git rebase origin/main
Make sure working tree is clean, or stash local changes first.
